claim: On the reserved untouched Hyperliquid region 2026-01-18..2026-04-30, the primary B1 volatility-only feature family is evaluated against C1/C2 funding-conditioned families for forward realized-volatility forecasting (QLIKE), using a chronological coin-pooled 60/7/3x10 design with 7-day embargo and non-overlapping 10-day test blocks. This is a materially different target family, estimand, and hypothesis from the completed forward liquidation cell TRACKA-LIQ-XSEC-FORWARD-20261113T222859Z (EXPLORATORY_NULL).

cannot: override, soften, or re-label any sealed time-series P2 verdict or the completed forward liq verdict
status_contract.rationale: Forward-reduced window on the reserved 2026Q1Q2 region evaluated under a frozen exploratory prereg; per-coin time-series forecasting estimand (QLIKE), not the cross-sectional liquidation ranking estimand.

why_this_is_new: The 2026-01-18..2026-04-30 Hyperliquid ironflow bulk region was reserved by prereg_tracka_vol_fullhist_20261112T201536Z but never scored for Arm A forward volatility. It is unopened, on-disk, and requires no external data.
venue: Hyperliquid (ironflow bulk: candles_1h + funding + open_interest + liquidations), CC-BY-4.0, unauthenticated.

candles_1h.warmup_note: 2025-12 loaded for 168h trailing-RV warm-up only; never scored.

open_interest.note: Secondary family only (B2/B3). Never pooled with the primary family.

liquidations.note: Used ONLY for coverage/universe eligibility by existence counts. Never as a volatility target and never read for outcomes of this cell.

acquisition.note: All inputs are on-disk cached ironflow bulk parquet (research_state/data_cache/ironflow_bulk/). No network.

universe.selection_rule: coverage-only, frozen ex ante, computed before any outcome: native perps (market endswith '-PERP' and contains no ':') with complete hourly candle AND funding AND open-interest coverage over the scoring test window 2026-02-10..2026-04-30.

unit: coin x 1h decision point (hour start, UTC)

targets.definition: RV_{t+1..t+24} = sum_{i=1..24} r_{t+i}^2, r = log(close_{t+i}/close_{t+i-1}), computed only from closes strictly after decision point t. Rows whose 24h label window crosses a block end are dropped.

features_causal.rule: Every feature at decision point t uses only closes/funding/OI with timestamp <= t. No forward fill of the target into features. All scaling statistics come from the train split only.
features_causal.rv1h: sum of squared trailing 1h log returns over the previous 1h
features_causal.rv24h: sum of squared trailing 1h log returns over the previous 24h
features_causal.rv168h: sum of squared trailing 1h log returns over the previous 168h
features_causal.funding_rate: latest settled fundingRate at or before t (as-of merge, backward, hour-floored)
features_causal.premium: latest settled premium at or before t (as-of merge, backward, hour-floored)
features_causal.ema_dist: close_t / EMA24(close)_t - 1, EMA span 24 computed causally on trailing closes

metric_definition: QLIKE(y, yhat) = y/yhat - log(y/yhat) - 1, averaged over paired test observations per coin; pooled mean over the primary family.

materiality_gate.relative_reduction_definition: 100 * (QLIKE_B1 - QLIKE_C2) / QLIKE_B1 on pooled paired test observations; positive favors C2
materiality_gate.ci_method: circular block bootstrap over time, block length 168h, 2000 reps, seed 20261114

multiplicity.primary_family_definition: 4 horizons (6h, 24h, 72h, 168h) x 3 contrasts (C2_vs_B1, C1_vs_B1, C2_vs_C1); Holm across all 12; every cell reported including failures.
multiplicity.secondary_family_definition: 4 horizons x 2 contrasts (B2_vs_B1, B3_vs_B1) on the open-interest features; Holm within the secondary family only; explicitly NOT promotable and NOT pooled with the primary family.

splits.method: chronological, coin-pooled; 7-calendar-day embargo between train and each test block and between consecutive test blocks; non-overlapping 10-day test blocks; no random split
splits.block_end_rule: Decision points whose label horizon extends past the block end are dropped (last H hours of each block for horizon H). Guarantees no scoring row reads outside its block.
splits.reserved_tail_never_scored: 2026-04-25..2026-04-30 held out of scoring as an in-window reserve; never read.

decision_rule.PROMOTE_CANDIDATE: all primary-gate conditions pass AND all promotion criteria report clean; status FORECAST_GATE_PASSED and only then may an overlay be considered (but max_status here is EXPLORATORY_ONLY, so never promotable).
decision_rule.NOT_MET: primary gate fails; preserve the null and record exact failing minima.
decision_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: a gate cannot be evaluated (e.g. <3 blocks with data, numerical instability); root-cause it, do not re-tune.
decision_rule.INADMISSIBLE: universe < 5 coins or panel empty after causal feature filtering; record exact failing minimum.

forbidden: Reading or scoring 2026-05-01..2026-10-31 for any purpose (sealed holdout)
Using liquidation labels as a volatility target for this cell (existence counts only)
Any Binance/2024 data, or mixing venues in one panel
Threshold, model, feature, or split tuning against test blocks
Re-scoring, re-weighting, or re-labelling sealed 2026-05..2026-10 volatility verdicts or the forward liq verdict
Using a secondary-family (open-interest) result to promote any claim
Agent-set RESOLVED_VERIFIED or fabricated=true; any Gate 4 bypass
Committing raw bulk parquet objects or caches
gate_4_note: Research-only, EXPLORATORY_ONLY, not promotable. Does not touch Gate 4.
